evidence.detail: site_resources splits args into area+detail and looks for sitemap endpoints starting with /{area}/; requires explicit prefixes like 'person', 'cards', 'archetype' — bare terms like 'bakert99' or 'Necropotence' don't match
resources_resources does fuzzy match against static resources dict only (help pages, links), not against live card/person/archetype data

triage.notes: Implementing the requested auto-detection (card vs person vs archetype from bare term) requires fetching all three name sets, fuzzy matching across them, and disambiguating conflicts — non-trivial scope with live API calls and UX decisions about tie-breaking.
